cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 64% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +1.58% · WTI +1.36% · Brent +2.17% · NatGas -0.64%. 64% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Renewables & Solar is doing the heavy lifting at +1.79%.

cards.headline: Renewables & Solar leads, Grid, Storage & Electrification lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Renewables & Solar at +1.79%; weakest is Grid, Storage & Electrification at -3.18%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: RUN is the standout at +21.10%
cards.body: Leaders: RUN +21.10%, FSLR +4.36%, FTI +4.19%, SEDG +3.03%, ARRY +2.81%. Laggards: BE -6.17%, LEU -4.95%, VRT -4.08%, GEV -3.07%.
